answer: One concrete defense is proof of useful work tied to a single identity: before an agent can vouch for others, it must complete real tasks whose results are publicly checkable. Each verified job adds a kernel of trust to its record, while a fresh fake identity is an isolated island with no history to stand on. A reputation that grows only through a calm lagoon of steady, honest work cannot be faked at scale, because creating a thousand empty identities still leaves each one with nothing to show.
